RemoteMessage::command: save-game transfer 2..6 (TransmitSaveGame/ReceiveSaveGame; Buka GAME.cpp RemoteSaveConstant numbering), chat 11 (PopNetBox and the ADVMGR/COMMAND/KB receivers), hero/town data 0x15 and its confirm 0x16 (Buka EVENTS.cpp CombatRemoteCommand), combat action 0x17 (ProcessNextAction / combatManager::Main), player exit 30 (HandleRemote*Exit). hexcell::m_obstacleIndex wall states for castle pieces: GenerateMap sets INTACT (8), Catapult sets INTACT_HIT 0x40 / DAMAGED_HIT 0x41 / COLLAPSING 0x42 then DAMAGED (10) or NONE (-1); hexcell::DrawObstacle switches on them (8/10 as tower frames). giWaitType: WaitHandler's switch runs WaitForOtherPlayer/WaitForGuest/WaitForHost/InitNetGuest/InitNetHost/GUIModemCommandExec/GUIModemResponseExec/WaitForDirectConnect for 0..7, stored by REMOTE and KB (Buka KBDeclarations.h DialogWaitType, same numbering; HoMM1 lacks the DirectPlay/Winsock members).
UnloadRemoteDriver switch: 0 com_term (serial: modem/direct connect), 1 nb_term (NetBIOS); RemoteCleanup passes them by RemoteGameMode.
com_init's baudRate switch: codes 1..5 map to CBR_2400/4800/9600/19200/38400 (default passes the value through); ModemSetup passes 4 (19200).

gConfig.musicSource: musicQualityText rows (8 Bit Mono, 8 Bit Stereo, CD Stereo); soundManager::PlayMusic picks .82m/.82s/.62s streams by it and Open/SetMusicQuality set m_cdReady for CD. kbwin.h PrefsConstant CONFIG_MUSIC_SOURCE_CD (2) is the same value of this domain (reuse lead for the kbwin owner).

cSpellHelp rows (previous/next page, adventure/combat spells, close, view spells, select spell, view combat spells) shown by CombatSpecialHandler and game::ViewSpells.

game::m_difficulty; retail gDifficultyNames {Easy, Normal, Hard, Expert}, the four new-game difficulty buttons (NEW_GAME_DIFFICULTY_FIRST + m_difficulty) and CalcDifficultyRating's 0..3 ladder; Buka GameDifficulty numbering (HoMM1 has no Impossible).
